```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)
library(cluster)
library(mclust)
```


## Data

```{r}
data(iris)
```

```{r}
summary(iris)
str(iris)
```

## Histograms

```{r}
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Length, fill = Species)) + 
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") 

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Width, fill = Species)) + 
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") 

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Petal.Length, fill = Species)) + 
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") 

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Petal.Width, fill = Species)) + 
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") 

```

## Points

```{r}
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point()
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point()

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Petal.Length, color = Species)) +
  geom_point()
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Width, y = Petal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point()
```

## Boxplots

```{r}


p_box_sl <- ggplot(iris, aes(x = Species, y = Sepal.Length, fill = Species)) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.25) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.colour = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colours) +
  labs(
    title = "Sepal length depending on the species of iris",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Sepal length (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


p_box_sw <- ggplot(iris, aes(x = Species, y = Sepal.Width, fill = Species)) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.25) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.colour = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colours) +
  labs(
    title = "Sepal width depending on the species of iris",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Sepal width (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_box_pl <- ggplot(iris, aes(x = Species, y = Petal.Length, fill = Species)) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.25) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.colour = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colours) +
  labs(
    title = "Petal length depending on the species of iris",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Petal length (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


p_box_pw <- ggplot(iris, aes(x = Species, y = Petal.Width, fill = Species)) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.25) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.colour = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colours) +
  labs(
    title = "Petal width depending on the species of iris",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Petal width (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
 

ggsave("results/iris_boxplot_sl.png", plot = p_box_sl,
       width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("results/iris_boxplot_sw.png", plot = p_box_sw,
       width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("results/iris_boxplot_pl.png", plot = p_box_pl,
       width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("results/iris_boxplot_pw.png", plot = p_box_pw,
       width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

## Plot matrix

```{r}
colours <- c(setosa = "#FDE725", versicolor = "#21908C", virginica = "#440154")

p <- ggpairs(
  iris,
  columns = 1:4,
  mapping = aes(color = Species, alpha = 0.7),
  upper   = list(continuous = "points"),
  lower   = list(continuous = "points"),
  diag    = list(continuous = wrap("barDiag", alpha = 0.5)),
  columnLabels = c("Sepal length", "Sepal width",
                   "Petal length", "Petal width")
) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colours) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colours) +
  theme_minimal()

p
ggsave("results/iris_scatter.png", p, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
